description: Search repositories by owner, name, owner/name or description, case-insensitively: every public repo, plus the private ones you own or collaborate on when authenticated. Omit `query` (authenticated) to list YOUR repositories — the ones you own or were invited to — instead of searching. Mirrors GET /api/v2/search/repos. `total` is the full match count (not the page size) and `nextOffset` pages through it.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Use `nextOffset` from the previous response.

query.description: Search keyword — matches owner login, repo name, owner/name and description. Omit to list your own repositories.

name: gluecron_search_repos
